Every group is decided once in tableDecisions (RECORD 51, REBUILD 13; no LIST, no PER MAN), every member is held by a fact on two hosts (api-web.nhle.com and hockey-reference.com), every man moved for a reason is in tableMoves with his fact, and every finding this round's checker made on the rows as exported is in exportFindings and fixed with its fact. watchRules: Written before the first decision. The season in play is 2026-27; the last finished one is 2025-26.

A club group is the only group dated, in the trailing "(as of 2025-26)" shape, whenever a man still playing on the board does not fit it (section 8). No other group is dated: a man moves or the group is rebuilt.
A career mark (games, goals, points): a man still playing within one season of it (82 games, 60 goals, 110 points, 80 assists) is watched.
A season mark ("Scored N goals in a season"): a man still playing whose best season since 2024-25 reached three quarters of N is watched.

Review fix of 2026-10-29, one rule since fix2-1574: beside every single season mark (every group whose kind is aged 'season', today "Scored N goals in a season", 60 on nhlconn-009 and 010, 70 on 011 and 012) the line is read on the career best, not only on the seasons since 2024-25. Every man still playing beside one is read on both hosts (watchLine, an entry per board, label and man) and leaves the board at three quarters of the mark or more (45 of 60, 52.5 of 70), the line that moved Leon Draisaitl (55 in 2021-22, 52 in 2024-25).
Goals for one franchise: a man still playing within 60 of the mark for one franchise is watched. Goalie wins: a goalie still playing within 45 wins.
Goals credited to a goalie: any goalie still playing who has none is watched.

An award: any man still playing who is eligible and has not won it is watched, with no judgement of how likely he is: the Vezina a goalie, the Norris a defenceman, the Calder a man still rookie eligible for 2026-27 (no earlier season over 25 games, not two earlier seasons of 6 or more), the Art Ross and the Rocket Richard a skater, the Hart and the Conn Smythe anyone. An award in a closed past range ("before 2000") is fixed.
A Conn Smythe in a losing cause: anyone still playing. Cups with three franchises: a man still playing with Cups for two.
The Hall of Fame with a club: anyone not in the Hall who played for the club, playing or not (the Hockey Hall of Fame inducts each November).
Fixed: the draft (overall pick, drafting club), the position, a Cup in a named past season or a finished run of seasons.
checkerGaps: At the true base count (Round 1567's checker over the table rows, 2026-10-29) nhlconn-005 showed Joe Sakic, Peter Forsberg and Nathan MacKinnon as not members of "Played for the Avalanche or Nordiques": the checker read "avalanche or nordiques" as one nickname no club name ends with. A gap in the checker, not the data: Round 1574's explicit club map reads both names, and each man is held to the group by a fact.

watchLine.about: Review fix of 2026-10-29 (review-read-1574 finding 1, the lead's ruling). The round's watch read a season mark only on the seasons since 2024-25, so it moved Leon Draisaitl (52 in 2024-25) off nhlconn-012 and kept Auston Matthews (69 in 2023-24) on nhlconn-011 and Connor McDavid (64 in 2022-23) on nhlconn-012 beside "Scored 70 goals in a season". Every man still playing beside that group on every NHL board is now read by his career best season on both hosts (each has a fact: watch-line when moved, watch-line-clear when kept), and the line is the one that moved Draisaitl, three quarters of the mark. At or over it he leaves the board; under it he stays. fix2-1574 (the lead's ruling on fix-1574): the same line is ONE rule for every single season mark on every NHL board, never a listed label. A group is a season mark by its kind (usConnectionsCheck.mjs AGES calls it 'season', and the checker reads it by seasonBest), and its line is three quarters of its own mark: 45 of 60 (nhlconn-009 and 010), 52.5 of 70 (011 and 012). The boards carry no other single season mark (no assists, points, wins or saves in a season). Beside the 60 goal group John Tavares (47 in 2018-19) was over the line and left nhlconn-010 for John Tonelli; Andrei Vasilevskiy (a goalie, 0) stays on 009. simUsConnectionsFacts section 5 holds every entry against the record and both hosts (controls watchline, watchline60, watchbest) and section 10 ties the kind to its age (control seasonage).
